text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordan rules out Iraq's involvement in August's riots in southern Jordan.
- U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan and French President Jacques Chirac discuss implementation of the oil-for-food deal.
- A group of Belgian businessmen arrive in Baghdad.
- A British organisation says U.N. envoy Rolf Ekeus conspires against Iraq and seeks to prolong trade sanctions.
- More international oil supertankers will arrive at Mina al-Bakr at the beginning of this month.
